The''' Gold bracelet''', attached to four gold finger '''rings''' by little chains, is a very powerful ''[[angreal]]'' aligned to ''[[Saidar]]'' the female half of the One Power. This strange jewelry was found in the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}} 

==Appearance==
It is a golden bracelet attached by four flat chains to finger rings, every bit engraved in an intricate mazelike pattern. It has a very little lock with a matching tiny tubular key dangling from a fine chan made to be removed, to assure it on the hand. Curiously it seems to adapt to any female hand, wrist and fingers.

==Use==
After it was discovered, [[Elayne]] handed it over to [[Nynaeve]],{{ref/book|8|5}} and since then it was usually used by [[Nynaeve]]. Only one time she lent it to [[Alivia]] to fight against the [[Forsaken]] during the [[Cleansing of saidin]].

Since [[Cadsuane]]'s weak [[Shrike]] ''angreal'' enables her to reach the strength of the top male level, it can be assumed that this very powerful bracelet ''angreal'' allows Nynaeve or Alivia to surpass that level by far.
